feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 7 May 2026 4:14pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 07 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Generally dry this evening and tonight with variable amounts of cloud and light or moderate southerly breezes. Temperatures 12 to 14 Celsius at first, then no lower than 7 degrees overnight.

Mainly dry tomorrow with sunny intervals developing after a rather cloudy start. Light breezes becoming a moderate to fresh northerly. Top temperature 14°C.


##Outlook##

Generally dry on Saturday with bright or sunny intervals. Moderate to fresh north or northeast wind, strengthening a little later. Temperatures reaching 14 or 15°C at best. Fine and mostly sunny on Sunday.
